title: NPT RevCon D-Day(5/22) — 오늘 폐회, 컨센서스 결과문서 채택 여부 최종 결정
snippet: NPT 11th Review Conference closes today (May 22). 191 states parties to decide on consensus outcome document. 5 major unresolved issues: Iran war/nuclear facility strikes, Iran NPT withdrawal bill, nuclear disarmament (P5 non-cooperation), Ukraine/Zaporizhzhia, CTBT. Astana Times: '190+ countries in final negotiations, consensus uncertain.' Previous 3 consecutive failures (2005, 2015, 2022). Last consensus outcome was 2010.
tag_reason: 5/21 보고서의 'NPT RevCon D-1'에서 오늘 'D-Day(폐회일)'로 업데이트. 합의 시한 도래라는 유의미한 시간적 진전.
